biggest_catch: Apple Trade In pays in store credit or Apple Gift Card, not cash - and your payout depends on your device's model and condition; you must own the item.
catches: Apple Trade In pays as instant credit toward a purchase or an Apple Gift Card - it does NOT pay cash, unlike direct buyback sites.
Payout depends on the exact device, model, configuration, and condition - you must own the item; the final credit is confirmed only after Apple verifies the device.
Devices with no trade-in value are recycled for free - you get nothing for them.
Values vary by market; published figures are US ranges.

It depends on the device, model, manufacturer, and condition - answer a few questions accurately, and once we receive the device and verify its condition, you'll most likely receive the full amount of the estimated refund.

steps: Start at apple.com/shop/trade-in and select the device you want to trade in.
Answer the condition questions to get an instant trade-in estimate.
Mail the device with the prepaid label or bring it to an Apple Store.
Receive instant credit toward your purchase or an Apple Gift Card once Apple verifies the device.
timing: Online mail-in takes ~2-3 weeks to process plus 3-5 business days for credit; in-store is on the spot; ~15-30 min active time per quote/ship/drop-off.
